about_the_game:
Survive in the Mine, Dig Deep, Upgrade!

You are imprisoned as a prisoner in the middle of the desert, in mines where light cannot reach. Here, your destiny is to work in the mine with your team, fill your daily quota and try to survive by paying your penance. But be careful… This mine is not just about stone and ore.

Upgrade and Become Strong!

Collect resources in the mine, earn money by selling various ores and valuable items. Rusty Bill is waiting for you in his store! Improve your equipment, get more advanced pickaxes, bags and equipment. But remember, too much extravagance can lead to death.

More Than Mining!

Every new day, you must dig deeper and find valuable metals and rare ores. However, as you dig, you will face the unknown that awaits you. As you dig deeper, secrets will be revealed and dangers in the darkness will reveal themselves.

Are you ready to face your fears and survive in the increasingly dark mines?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K OR AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Core i7-9700K OR AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: You are condemned to darkness in the vast deserts. To survive, you must dig deeper every day with your team, improve your skills, and acquire powerful equipment. But remember… this mine is not just full of stones and ores. Stay alert to the dangers that await you. Dig, get stronger, and survive!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Greek, Czech, Swedish
